name: TypingAnimation
description: Text that types itself out one character at a time, with an optional blinking cursor and an optional loop. The full text is in the page from the start.

delay.description: Seconds to wait before typing starts.

cursor.description: Shows a blinking cursor after the text.

loop.description: Types the text again after a short pause, once it has finished.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation and shows the finished text. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

requirements: The full text is present as visually hidden text from the first render, so assistive technology reads it once, never letter by letter
With no JavaScript, or with reduced motion, the finished text is shown at once
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
screenReader: The full text is read once, immediately; the typing is not announced

use_when: A short tagline or terminal-style line in a hero
avoid_when: Text people must read the moment the page loads
anti_patterns: Looping text that is also the only place a message appears
Typing speeds so slow the text takes many seconds to finish
